prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 会议室预订周视图（5/12–5/16） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "2025 春季校园招聘宣讲会（09:00–17:" spans 3 col × 1 row; "产品需求评审（09:00–12:00）｜A301" spans 1 col × 2 row; "新员工入职培训（13:30–16:30）｜C20" spans 1 col × 2 row; "客户方案演示与答疑（13:30–16:30）｜A" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "时间段" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 94px
  col 2: header "周一（5/12）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 261px
  col 3: header "周二（5/13）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 214px
  col 4: header "周三（5/14）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 274px
  col 5: header "周四（5/15）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 304px
  col 6: header "周五（5/16）" · longest unbreakable word 62px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按时间段查看一周内的会议室预订，识别活动、时间和地点。","reading":"读者先沿左侧时间段定位，再横向比较各日安排；也会纵向查看某一天的预订。跨列活动表示连续多日，跨行活动表示覆盖多个时间段。","groups":["第1列是时间轴，应与各行保持清晰对应。","第2至第6列均为工作日，承担相同的日程展示作用，宽度应具有可比性。","横跨周三至周五的全天活动共享这三列的宽度；跨行活动可利用所覆盖的行高容纳换行。"],"keep_intact":["日期表头、时间段和会议时间中的数字与标点尽量保持完整。","会议室编号及线上等地点标识应保持完整，并易于与对应活动关联。","跨行或跨列活动的文字应仍能明确对应其覆盖的时间和日期。"],"may_wrap":["活动名称可按中文自然换行。","活动名称、括号内时间和分隔符后的地点可在彼此之间换行。","已有较高行或跨行单元格可吸收部分换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [85, 130, 122, 128, 132, 122] · table 720×487px · row heights [36, 60, 106, 83, 60, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [94, 125, 122, 126, 128, 124] · table 720×487px · row heights [36, 60, 106, 83, 60, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [79, 128, 128, 128, 128, 128] · table 720×464px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 83, 60, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"日期表头完整，工作日列宽接近，便于横向比较。周四较宽，跨行的客户演示内容仍能与其覆盖的时间段对应。","problems":"周二例会被拆成四行，连带拉高上午第一时段；左侧时间段均分成两行。全天活动的地点也折到第二行。","cause":"周二列为122px，可用文字宽度仅101px，容不下例会时间与地点的较好组合；时间列85px不足以容纳单行时间段。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"时间列比r1A宽，日期表头完整，工作日列仍有相近的视觉节奏。","problems":"额外分配给时间列的宽度没有让时间段保持单行；周二例会仍为四行并撑高整行。周四跨行活动的名称和时间也较零碎。","cause":"时间列94px扣除边距后只有73px，仍小于时间段所需的94px；周二列仍为122px，周四列从132px缩至128px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"五个工作日等宽，列的角色和比较关系清楚。周二例会比前两版少占一行，使上午第一时段更紧凑；日期表头也都完整。","problems":"时间段仍分成两行，且时间列较窄；部分活动的时间、地点与名称分散在多行。全天活动的地点仍被拆到下一行。","cause":"时间列79px不足以容纳单行时间段；工作日各128px，虽改善了周二例会，但对较长的活动及其时间、地点仍有限制。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"周二优先","widths":[79,125,134,126,130,125],"change":"以r1C为基础，增加周二列宽以稳定例会时间和地点的排布，并略增周四列宽照顾较长的跨行活动；从其他工作日各借少量宽度，保留相近的列节奏。"},{"name":"时间轴完整","widths":[115,121,124,120,120,119],"change":"将时间列增至115px，为94px的单行时间段留足空间；五个工作日维持接近的宽度，检验更清晰的纵向时间轴是否值得活动内容增加换行。"},{"name":"均衡微调","widths":[79,127,130,127,129,127],"change":"保留r1C紧凑的时间列和近乎等宽的工作日结构，向周二及周四各增加少量空间，检验能否改善较长活动而不明显削弱其他列。"}]}
